title: Financial Maths: Profit and Loss, Discount, VAT, Budgets and Simple Interest
seo_title: Grade 7 Financial Maths Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve problems that involve whole numbers, percentages and decimal fractions in financial contexts such as profit, loss, discount and VAT, budgets, accounts, loans and simple interest.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 financial maths worksheets: profit and loss, discount, VAT at 15%, budgets and simple interest. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Profit = income − cost. If the answer is negative, it is a loss.
  • Discount: subtract the percentage from the price.
  • VAT in South Africa is 15%: add 15% to the price before VAT.
  • Simple interest = principal × rate × years: R2 000 at 8% for 3 years = R480.

Examples

Example

R2 000 at 8% simple interest for 3 years

8% of R2 000 = R160

3 × R160

Answer: R480 interest

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
One item onlyMultiply by the number of items.
Adding the discountDiscount makes the price smaller.
One year of interestMultiply by the number of years.
